properties.description:
The plain-language entry surface: what reflow2 physically is, how it runs on the reader's own machine, what it can answer that nothing else can, and the first thing they would actually type — before any doctrine. Realized by documentation rather than by code, which is why it is a capability with no module: what satisfies it is prose and a picture.

✅ BUILT 2026-08-29 — BL-102. `README.md` gains a first section, "What it actually is, concretely", sitting before Vision: the physical shape in four sentences, a mermaid diagram of agent → MCP → binary → the two files in your own repo, the one-line install with "there is nothing to put in your project", the three first moves as a table, and the four questions it can answer that nothing else can. The top banner now points INTO that section rather than away from the file.

⭐ IT DELIBERATELY MIRRORS THE `help` SKILL, AND THE DUPLICATION IS THE POINT. Two doors, two audiences: the skill answers someone who already has an agent and asks it; this answers a stranger who lands on the repository with neither. `cap:a-newcomer-can-ask-the-agent-what-this-is` satisfies `req:explains-itself` only PARTIALLY for exactly that reason, and this closes the other half. If the two ever disagree, the README is the one a stranger meets first.

🛑 AND THE REWRITE FOUND SEVEN STALE FACTS, which is the more transferable result. Tools 114 → 165, skills 15 → 25, core modules 40 → 59, edge types 60 → 64; the file contradicted itself on the vocabulary counts; `install.sh` was listed in the wrong directory; and — in the first screen a stranger reads — "**The store** is dynograph-foundation" had been FALSE SINCE 2026-08-24, when that subset was absorbed and the dependency ended.

⚠️ THE README IS THE ONE DOCUMENT WITH NO CHECK BEHIND IT. `skill_lint` guards the skills, `reflow2_check` guards design against build, `check_intent_authority` guards settled intent — and the file a stranger reads first carried 114 tools while 165 were served, with nothing anywhere able to say so. No check was added: a lint parsing prose for counts would be brittle and would fire on correct rewording. The numbers are right today and will drift again, and saying so is the honest position rather than pretending a fix.
properties.name: Explain itself to someone who has not been convinced yet
